strings.name: Lai Ching-te
strings.summary: Trained in medicine and public health, Lai worked in internal medicine and nephrology before entering elected office and local government. He served as Tainan mayor, premier and vice president before becoming Taiwan’s president in 2024. His cross-strait, security and defence policies attract international attention, while his administration faces legislative divisions and fiscal and social-policy debates.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; reviewed on 15 November. This is not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Moved from medicine and local administration into Taiwan’s political leadership; his cross-strait and security policies receive international attention.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Wanli, Taiwan, now part of New Taipei City.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Medical training at National Taiwan University and National Cheng Kung University; Harvard public-health master’s (2003).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Medicine to public affairs
strings.highlights.h1.text: Moved from clinical medicine to elected office, Tainan government and executive leadership.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Security and cross-strait policy
strings.highlights.h2.text: As Taiwan’s president since 2024, his defence and cross-strait positions influence East Asian security debates.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Promoted defence-budget proposal
strings.timeline.t1.text: Advocated a proposed record defence budget for 2027, describing it as an investment in peace.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Became Taiwan’s president
strings.timeline.t2.text: Took office after winning the 2024 election.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Became DPP chairman
strings.timeline.t3.text: Began leading the Democratic Progressive Party after an internal election.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Became vice president
strings.timeline.t4.text: Took office as Tsai Ing-wen’s deputy after their election victory.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Became premier
strings.timeline.t5.text: Moved from Tainan mayor to premier, serving until 2019.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Became Tainan mayor
strings.timeline.t6.text: Became the first mayor of the newly merged Tainan municipality.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Earned public-health master’s
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed a Harvard public-health master’s while serving as a legislator.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Entered legislature
strings.timeline.t8.text: Began serving in the Legislative Yuan and was reelected several times.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Entered elected office
strings.timeline.t9.text: Left clinical practice and entered the National Assembly.
